items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He kept running around so after a while he met Brother John Sellers. John Sellers started pushing with him

ctx.x: What brought you and Alvin Henry(?) together?

Peter, and Brother John. Peter went to all the ballets. He thinks everything I do is so great. I said, one day you're going to be disappointed. He said, you should do a ballet. He went to all the ballets trying to get me do something. After he found out that Katherine Dunham dance one of my things - I said, "Peter, I don't want to be with the ballet." He kept running around so after a while he met Brother John Sellers. John Sellers started pushing with him and the next thing I knew - well you see, Alvin Ailey is…

been away a long time. It's just like me coming out fresh but you have a better chance because I did have a little name when I stopped." So I told him some things to do and he caught on fast on his own.
